newsitem.title: GERMANY: Buderus expects higher earnings in 1996/97.
newsitem.headline: Buderus expects higher earnings in 1996/97.

text.p: German heating and appliance group Buderus AG said on Wednesday it expected to see good sales and earnings growth in 1996/97, but said first-half growth levels could not be extrapolated for the full year.
"Despite the decrease in competitive pressures in our different sales areas, it would still be premature to estimate full-year growth based on development so far," Buderus said in a statement.
The group said that its pre-tax profits increased by 16 million marks ($9.4 million) to 83 million marks ($48.8 million) in the six months to the end of March 1997.
Sales in the first half of 1996/97 grew seven percent to 1.587 billion marks.
Buderus said that growth in foreign markets, at 12 percent, was stronger than average.
